lines.text: Paul says that by the law we eagerly await through the Spirit the hope of righteousness, and that in Christ Jesus what matters is faith expressing itself through love (Galatians 5:5-6).

Paul says they were called to freedom, so serve one another in love, because the entire law is fulfilled in a single decree, which is to love your enemies, and he warns them to watch out, or they will be consumed by one another if they keep on biting and devouring one another (Galatians 5:13-15).
